# Parañaque Doctors Hospital (PDH)

> Parañaque Doctors Hospital (PDH) is a premier Level 2 healthcare institution located in the heart of Parañaque City. It is committed to ensuring the well-being of its community by continuously providing high-quality and affordable healthcare services.

Information below comes from PDH's published website. Schedules and locations can change; patients should call 8776-0644 to 46 to confirm.

## Emergency

- The Emergency Room is open 24/7 on the Ground Floor.
- Emergency hotline: 8776 0645 to local 8106 or 0921 572 0589

## Contact

## Key pages

- [Find a Doctor](https://pdh-website-revamp.vercel.app/doctors/): search 289 doctors by name, specialty, department and clinic day; each doctor has a profile page with their clinic schedule.
- [Services & Facilities](https://pdh-website-revamp.vercel.app/services/): every service with its location, opening hours and phone number.
- [Find Your Way](https://pdh-website-revamp.vercel.app/directory/): floor-by-floor hospital directory.

## About

Founded on May 8, 2007, by visionary doctors, PDH officially became a member of the Metro Pacific Health (MPH) Group in 2024 — the largest Philippine private hospital network in the country under the Metro Pacific Investments Corporation (MPIC), led by Mr. Manuel V. Pangilinan.
As member of the MPH network, PDH shares the same goal in providing medical excellence and compassionate care to all our patients.

- Mission: To deliver “Alagang PDH”, our unique way of delivering high quality and compassionate care that is affordable, accessible, and patient-centered.
- Vision: To be the leading healthcare provider, renowned for medical excellence, compassionate care, innovative healthcare services, and dedicated commitment to the well-being of the community.
